cells.gaps: No fact inside the three years says births are entered at the office: the Division's 2023/2024 report says its CSD System registers births and deaths into one database (MUS-015, MUS-016) without saying where the entry is made, and the 2025 notice opens the offices for registration during the system's revamp (MUS-005 to MUS-007) without a count. The Registrar's account of online entry at computerised offices (MUS-022, MUS-023) dates from 2019, and the Pay Research Bureau's 'all offices' (MUS-025, MUS-026) is its 2016 review, uploaded in 2024; both fall outside the window. The Division counts 36 local offices in 2023/2024. The plan held (MUS-018) is the Strategic Directions for 2023/2024, a period ended before the as-at, and nothing is dated inside the twelve months.
cells.note: The Division's own system registers births and deaths in its local offices, live since 2001 and being revamped in 2025, which meets stage 3. Stage 4 needs a source inside three years saying the entry is made at the office, with a share or a count of offices against a total; the only such statements date from 2016 and 2019.
